detailed_description:
The target video uses a live-action cinematic style with cold tones, low saturation, fast cutting, and aggressive camera movement.
[Shot 1] A dynamic tracking shot opens mid-combat in <Subject 4>, the frozen bog. <Subject 3>, the lantern fisherman, swings his staff horizontally and fires three rapid dark-green energy bolts in succession. <Subject 1>, the bone-masked warlock, slides sideways across the ice at high speed to dodge the first two bolts, the third exploding against a rock behind him and sending mud and ice shards flying. <Subject 2>, the antlered crone, backflips over the fourth bolt, her cloak snapping in the wind, and lands in a low crouch. The camera trucks left with large amplitude at fast speed, following the action.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a close tracking shot. <Subject 1> pushes off the ice with his staff and launches forward in a fast glide, closing the distance to <Subject 3> in an instant. He swings his horned staff in a wide horizontal arc, and a curved blade of ice extends from the staff tip, slashing toward <Subject 3>'s torso. The camera pushes in with large amplitude at fast speed.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot. <Subject 3> twists his body sideways, the ice blade slicing through the air just inches from his chest and shaving off a chunk of his shoulder rope. He retaliates instantly, whipping the fishing net forward; the net transforms mid-air into a black tendril whip that cracks toward <Subject 1>'s head. <Subject 2> charges in from the right at full sprint, her crescent staff glowing bright green, and slashes the tendril whip apart with a single vertical strike. Green sparks erupt from the impact. The camera pans right with large amplitude at fast speed.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle medium shot. <Subject 3> staggers back two steps, then roars and slams his staff into the ground. Dark green miasma bursts from the earth in a ring, condensing into three snarling ghost-face projectiles that shoot toward both protagonists from different angles. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> immediately sprint toward each other, converging at high speed. The camera tilts up with medium amplitude at fast speed.
[Shot 5] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a close two-shot. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> meet back-to-back in the center. <Subject 1> spins his staff rapidly, generating a swirling ice vortex that shreds the first two ghost faces on contact. <Subject 2> slams her crescent staff downward, and a wall of thorny vines bursts from the ground to impale the third ghost face. The camera orbits around them with large amplitude at fast speed.
[Shot 6] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a wide shot. <Subject 3> leaps into the air, raising his staff overhead with both hands. The skull on his staff opens its jaw wide, charging a massive dark-green energy orb that crackles with black lightning. He hurls it downward at the two protagonists. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> raise their staves simultaneously and cross them in front of their bodies. <Subject 1>'s ice energy and <Subject 2>'s green nature energy merge into a spiraling blue-white beam that fires upward.
[Shot 7] At 00:13.500, a slow-motion wide shot captures the dark-green orb and the blue-white beam colliding dead-center. The impact generates a violent shockwave that rips across the bog, shattering ice, uprooting stakes, and sending a massive column of snow and mud exploding into the air. The frame freezes at the peak of the explosion, debris suspended mid-air, blue-white and dark-green light clashing in the center.

overall_soundscape:
Rapid whooshes of energy bolts and ice blades cut through the howling wind, followed by the crack of the tendril whip and the sharp clang of staff against staff. Explosions of dark magic and ice thunder in quick succession, with the snarl of ghost faces and the roaring collision of final spells building to a deafening boom.

non_diegetic_music:
Fast-paced percussion with rapid taiko drum hits and driving low strings at a high tempo, layered with dissonant brass stabs that accelerate toward the final collision, cutting to silence at the freeze-frame.
